title: Online User Agreement pages p1-p7 as vtex1 DDS from the PS3 http-cache (u3fix eula-pages, eula-batch/make_eula.cpp)
notes: The 7 pages are the JPEGs BCES-EN-1..7 the PS3 game cached in DATA2/USRDIR/http-cache (recognised by content sha256): decode, flip and JPEG q95 4:4:4 re-save with libjpeg-exact integer DCTs (the re-save is part of the reference), ffmpeg lanczos mips, DXT5. Verified 2026-11-05: 7/7 byte-identical (then Pillow 13.0.0 + ffmpeg 8.1.1, msys2 clang64); the C++ port of 2026-11-13 gives the same 7/7, and its built-in resize without ffmpeg equals the old Pillow fallback byte for byte (equivalent pages, 75-88 % identical DXT blocks). The helper-side EULA page code (eula_port.c.txt / apply_eula.py) is a helper build change, not part of this step.
